title: How Seahawks powered Mike Macdonald's trademark awkward pause into the secret ingredient that crushed Drake Maye and the Patriots

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How Seahawks powered Mike Macdonald's trademark awkward pause into the secret ingredient that crushed Drake Maye and the Patriots
sources.description: Mike Macdonald, the "Defensive Sean McVay," drew up a superb scheme to lift the Seahawks to a Super Bowl title. One prime example: His use of CB Devon Witherspoon, who crushed the Patriots — as a rusher.
